identificationModule.briefTitle: Study for Patients With Non Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized Phase II Study to Determine the Efficacy of a Three Weekly vs. Weekly Therapy With Paclitaxel Plus Carboplatin vs. Paclitaxel Plus Vinorelbine for Patients With Non Small Cell Lung Cancer According to UICC Stage IIIB and IV

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a randomized study to assess the efficacy and safety of chemotherapy with platin compared to chemotherapy without platin.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Randomized Phase II design, multicenter study, to assess the efficacy and safety of combined chemotherapy with Paclitaxel and Carboplatin versus a platinum free chemotherapy with Paclitaxel and Vinorelbine, within the combination therapies there are two different dosing intervals, which will be assessed as well (4 Arm study).

keywords: curative non-treatable NSCLC UICC stage IIIB and IV

primaryOutcomes.measure: Determination of response rate (stable disease [SD] or better)
Determination of safety of the combination and life quality

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chemotherapy naive patients with histologically confirmed NSCLC stage III and IV

Exclusion Criteria:

* New York Heart Association (NYHA) III or IV
* Brain metastases
* Neurotoxicity Grade 2 or greater
